app.name: AI Usage Sidebar
forecast.paceLeft: On pace for {p}% left at reset
status.hint.claude.not_logged_in: Not signed in — run Claude Code and log in to see quotas.
status.hint.codex.not_logged_in: Not signed in — run `codex login` to see quotas.
status.hint.not_logged_in: Not signed in — log in with the provider's CLI to see quotas.
status.hint.claude.token_expired: Login expired — open Claude Code to refresh the token.
status.hint.codex.token_expired: Login expired — run `codex login` to refresh the token.
status.hint.token_expired: Login expired — sign in again to refresh the token.
status.hint.rate_limited: The provider is rate-limiting the usage endpoint — showing values from {ago}; next attempt in {next}.
popover.title: {provider} Usage
extras.title: Also reported
ring.runsOut: On pace to run out before the reset
overview.noProviders: No providers enabled. Enable one in Settings.
history.costNote: Estimate — subscriptions don't bill per token.
history.costMissingNote: Some records have no matching model price, so the total cost is unknown. Group by model to see estimates for models with known prices.
history.partialCostNote: Only records with known prices are included; {count} unpriced requests are excluded.
history.costApproxNote: Some models are priced from the closest known family; those costs are approximate.
history.budget.title: Monthly budget
history.budget.stat: {percent} of the monthly budget used · on pace for {pace} of {budget}
history.budget.incomplete: Some models have no price, so this month's total is a lower bound.
history.budget.accessible: Cumulative estimated cost this month against the monthly budget. The same values are in the table below.
history.budget.tokensHint: Switch “Show” to Est. cost to see the budget.
chart.missingPrices: Some models have no price. Their cost is unknown and omitted from this chart; the chart may show only a partial estimate.
history.activity.hint: Pick a day to narrow the range below.
history.activity.accessible: Activity heatmap. The same values are available in the table below.
history.table.title: Buckets
history.sessions.title: Sessions
history.sessions.capped: Showing the {shown} largest of {total} sessions by tokens.
history.sessions.linkNote: Range, provider and project carry over. Search, sorting, details and efficiency insights live in the Sessions tab.
settings.percentPosition.hint: Centre replaces the provider logo. It is shown only while the percent label is enabled.
settings.labelContent.hint: What the sidebar label shows. On a top or bottom bar the countdown is written next to the percentage. In the centre position the percentage stays in the centre and the countdown goes below.
settings.ringStyle.hint: Compact shows each provider as slim progress bars with a small logo, for a much smaller footprint.
settings.sidebarAnimations.hint: One short animation when a window enters the warning or critical zone, and a flash when it resets. Off automatically with reduced motion.
settings.sidebarItems.hint: Hidden items are still tracked: every provider keeps being polled, and the dashboard, the history and the near-the-limit warnings keep every limit.
settings.popoverTimeoutSec.hint: Seconds without any pointer activity on the bar or the popover. A pinned popover gets six times as long. 0 = never.
settings.refreshIntervalSec.hint: Claude is never polled more often than every 2 min.
settings.adaptiveRefresh.hint: Poll a provider less often while its session logs are quiet.
settings.forecastNotifications: Warn when on pace to run out early
settings.focus.hint: Silences native notifications for a while. Also available from the tray menu.
settings.focus.active: Focus mode is on, notifications are silenced.
settings.focusHidesSidebar: Hide the sidebar during focus mode
settings.hideAccountEmail.hint: Masks it as h•••@g•••.com everywhere, for screenshots and screen sharing.
settings.autoPricingCheck.hint: Checks the official project price list, or your custom URL, independently of program updates.
settings.shortcutWayland: Global shortcuts need X11/XWayland — a native Wayland session may ignore them.
settings.shortcutInvalid: Not a usable shortcut. Use modifiers and one key, e.g. Ctrl+Alt+U.
settings.sizeHint: Applies immediately; the bar re-measures itself.
settings.providers.hint: “Track” polls the provider and feeds the dashboard; “Bar” only decides whether it appears on the floating bar.
settings.provider.experimental.hint: Built from the tool's published source, never verified against a live account — the numbers may be wrong or stop working.
settings.pricingUrl.hint: Optional. Empty uses the official project price list; an https URL uses your chosen source instead.
settings.monthlyBudgetHint: 0 hides the budget line. Estimated cost only — subscriptions don't bill per token.
settings.quotaRetentionHint: 0 keeps it forever. Older quota samples are thinned to one per hour after 14 days. Token usage history is never deleted.
settings.pricing.customSource: A manually saved price table is active. It will not be replaced automatically.
settings.pricing.useSourceConfirm: Your manually saved price table will be backed up, then replaced with prices from the current source. Continue?
settings.pricing.saveCustomHint: Saving activates this manual table and prevents direct source-price application until you switch back.
settings.pricing.saveFirst: Save or discard your price edits first.
settings.pricing.none: No pricing rows — unknown models show “—” as cost.
update.managed: This copy was installed by a package manager or a script — download the new version from the release page.
pricingUpdate.unknown: Pricing has not been checked yet
pricingUpdate.customAvailable: Source pricing {revision} is available. Your manually saved table remains active.
pricingUpdate.upToDate: Pricing is up to date · checked {ago}
chart.noData: No usage recorded in this range.
history.invalidRange: Choose valid dates with the end date on or after the start date.
history.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Use Export CSV to save the data instead.
settings.pricing.invalid: Use unique, non-empty model prefixes and non-negative prices.
chart.accessible: Usage chart. The same values are available in the table below.
history.quota.title: Quota history
history.quota.scopeNote: Follows the time range and provider above. Quotas apply to the whole account, regardless of project or model grouping.
history.quota.observedNote: Increases add up changes between recorded samples, excluding reset and plan transitions. Usage between samples cannot be fully reconstructed. Dashed lines mark reset or plan transitions.
history.quota.empty: No quota records in this range. Available quotas are recorded automatically while the app runs.
history.quota.accessible: Quota percentage over time. Exact values and changes are in the table below.
history.modelDetailsNote: Model names and reasoning effort come from local session logs. Original model names are preserved; missing effort is not inferred.
history.quota.guidesNote: Dotted lines mark the warning and critical thresholds; a dashed segment projects the current pace to the reset or to 100 %.
history.quota.cycles.title: Quota cycles
history.quota.cycles.accessible: Peak used percentage of each quota cycle. The same values are in the table below.
history.quota.cycles.perPercentNote: Median over the last {n} complete cycles with full coverage.
history.quota.cycles.partialHint: The app was not sampling the quota near the end of this cycle, so the peak may be too low.
history.quota.cycles.note: Estimate: a cycle starts one window length before its reset deadline and counts the local session-log tokens of that provider in it. Other devices and web usage are not seen, so figures are approximate.
history.roi.title: Subscription value (estimate)
history.roi.projected: At the current pace: ≈ {projected} ({multiple}×) by month end.
history.roi.unset: {provider}: set your subscription price in Settings to compare it with your usage.
history.roi.note: Estimate only. API-equivalent cost is what these tokens would cost at pay-as-you-go prices; a subscription is not billed per token.
history.roi.incomplete: Some models have no price, so the API-equivalent figure is a lower bound.
history.roi.accessible: Cumulative estimated cost this month against the subscription price.
settings.subscriptionHint: 0 = unknown. Used only to compare the API-equivalent estimate with what you pay.
settings.subscriptionSuggest: Plan hint: about {price}. Confirm against your bill.
history.kpi.title: Usage summary
history.kpi.noBaselineLabel: No data in the previous period to compare with
history.kpi.note: Change versus the previous period of the same length, by calendar day; a day still in progress is compared with a full one. Cache hit rate = cache read / (input + cache read + cache write).
history.composition.title: Token composition
history.composition.note: Share of each token type per bucket; the line is the cache hit rate.
history.composition.accessible: Token composition: 100 % stacked bars of input, cache read, cache write, output and reasoning tokens per bucket, with the cache hit rate as a line. The same values are in the data table below.
chart.unpricedRequests: {count} requests have no model price and are not included in this cost; the chart may show only a partial estimate.
chart.clickToNarrow: Click to narrow the range to this bucket
history.mix.title: Model mix over time
history.mix.note: Share of tokens per model in each bucket; the smallest models are folded into Other.
history.mix.accessible: Model mix over time: 100 % stacked areas, one layer per model. The same values are in the data table below.
history.effort.title: Reasoning effort
history.effort.note: Share of tokens by recorded reasoning effort.
history.projects.title: Top projects
history.projects.hint: Click a project to filter everything above and below to it.
history.projects.sessionsCapped: session counts cover only the largest 1,000 sessions
history.projects.rowLabel: {name}: {tokens} tokens, {cost}, cache hit {hit}, {sessions} sessions. Activate to filter by this project.
history.activity.insight: Your peak is {from}–{to}h: {share}% of {metric} fall in that window; {weekday} is your busiest day.
history.empty.ingestDisabled.title: Reading session logs is turned off
history.empty.ingestDisabled.hint: Usage history is built from the local session logs of Claude Code and Codex. Turn on “Read local session logs” in Settings to start recording.
history.empty.noLogs.title: No session logs were found
history.empty.noLogs.hint: The last scan did not find any session log files. Use Claude Code or Codex once, or check that their config directories are in the default place (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME), then rescan.
history.empty.filtered.title: No usage matches these filters
history.empty.filtered.hint: There is usage in other ranges or for other providers or projects. Clear the provider and project filters, or pick a longer range.
history.empty.range.title: No usage recorded in this range
history.empty.range.hint: Nothing was logged in this period. Try a longer range, or rescan if you expect recent sessions to appear.
history.budget.notSet: No monthly budget is set. Set one in Settings to see the month-to-date burn-up here.
history.budget.unpriced: {count} requests this month have no model price and are not in this total, so it is a lower bound.
